contentHtml:
A professional presence starts with the right domain name and a matching email address. A free Gmail or Hotmail address quietly undersells a real business, and it is an easy thing to fix. I help you pick and register a good domain and set up a custom email that fits, working across all your devices. Because it rarely needs to happen on your own computer, I can do it onsite around Stretton and Brisbane or handle the whole thing remotely.

What is included

  • Domain name selection and registration. A quick chat to land on a domain that suits your business and is easy for customers to remember, then help getting it registered and secured.
  • Custom email setup. Professional email that matches your domain, for example yourname@yourbusiness.com.au, set up and working across your phone, laptop and everything else you use.
  • Deliverability sorted. SPF, DKIM and DMARC configured so your email actually lands in inboxes instead of the spam folder.

Look more professional straight away

A custom domain and email make a stronger first impression, build trust, and keep your business communication tidy and separate from your personal accounts. Onsite or remote, whichever suits you. If you want the mailboxes on a bigger platform, see my Google Workspace and Office 365 setup, and if you are wrestling with an existing account, there is email setup.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
